race_distance_inputs: Scheduled distance and leader distance between start and end signals exclude formation laps. Final classified distance is separate. No distance is inferred from a finish order or neutralisation flag.
race_control_input: Longest run of complete consecutive leader laps without SC or VSC. Unknown is an error, not a points-eligible default.
race_ties: Competition ranks; equally share the points of all occupied places, including places outside the points table.
unresolved_championship_ties: Model convention: retain the tied rank interval and divide title mass equally, without identity-based adjudication.
scope: Grand Prix scoring only; adjudicated outcomes, without sprint points or historical fastest-lap bonuses. Deterministic rules do not establish a generative or calibrated model for lapping, race stoppages, correlated incidents, DNS, disqualifications or penalties.
